printed.title: Cash Account—February.
printed.description: Printed 'Received.' and 'Paid.' dollar/cents column rules at right; blue horizontal rules.

handwriting.note: Written above the printed title at top right in dark brown ink; the printed title is NOT struck. Begins an income account continued on facing page 0392 (payees and amounts).

Dark brown ink. '15th' is cramped, written partly over the '1' of 'Mar 1st'; the ditto under 'Mar' gives Mar 15th. The four dates appear to pair with the five payee/amount lines on 0392 (counts do not match one-to-one).

Fainter grey ink/pencil: continuation of photograph section B from 0390 (B 5-12), then section C 1-2 (continued on 0392). Ditto marks are written between the numbered lines (above the text of 7, 9, 11 and below 11); each set assigned to the empty even-numbered line (6, 8, 10, 12) as ditto of the line above - an interpretation. '(spoiled)' after Chimney Butte faint. 'Sylvane' as written.

marks.note: Faint mirrored writing from the reverse page (0390) visible.

transcriber_notes: Two uses: income-account dates (dark ink) and photograph list (grey). Year 1884 for the dates is inferred from '1884' written on facing page 0392. CHANGE from pass-1: pass-1 note called lines 5-12 'section A'; they continue section B (B 1-4 are on 0390).
